mentions.name: Colorhunt
mentions.description: A photo scavenger hunt game where players are assigned a random colour and have 24 hours to go out and take photos matching it; the game then generates a photo grid from everything captured. Solo mode asks for 9 photos by yourself, with newly added palette (3 assigned colours) and rainbow (9 colours) modes, 1v1 mode pits you against a friend with a combined grid at the end, and squad mode has everyone contribute to a 20-photo grid with a room option to take breaks, react to uploaded photos, or spectate. No accounts, no app install, no personal data stored; photos and generated grids auto-delete after 24 hours from Cloudflare R2 storage.
